reviews.t: A great product for a great price!
reviews.x: I love my hair straight but curly at the end and I love how I can achieve both using only this machine 👏🏻. It heats up pretty quickly and is so easy to use. I love that they included a glove and hair clips in the package. Now I won’t need to worry about burning my fingers while curling my hair anymore. Overall, a great product for a great price!

reviews.t: Best All in One Hair Straightener - Curler on Amazon!
reviews.x: I love this hair straightener because some days I like to straighten my hair and other days I love to have it wavy. This straightener does it all. It is light weight, easy to use, and does a great job. The customer service is great as well.

reviews.t: Super easy to use for beginners
reviews.x: I love this product. I've never used a straightener/curler combo before so was unsure of what or how to even hold the product but after reading the basic instructions and giving it a couple tries I know my hair is going to look good after each use & for an extra bonus it comes with a few little accessories (comb ,clips ,heat glove) that weren't expected which is always a good thing in my opinion.

So far I really like this straightener. It works well, heats up fast and the plates are smooth and even temperature. The long cord is nice as well. Definitely use the heat glove. The outside of the wand does get hot. It included it and the clips in the package which was a great bonus. Over all I'm happy with it so far and I'm sure I'll get a lot of use out of it.

I really enjoyed using this product on my daughters hair! It didn't work for my hair (my hair is very thick, coarse, and long). My girls' hair is short and thick and it was perfect! I love the curved barrel for curls and i love how the plates move along with your hair. Minimal hair pulling/breakage occured. very satisfied

I could not keep the cord from getting twisted as I used it, which would unplug it from the wall. No matter what heat I used it at my hair was left feeling fried.  I could never get waves as a result. It would be kinked or a full reglet instead. I ended up very frustrated with this device and will return it.

reviews.t: All Around Best Of Both World's Hair Straightener and Curler..
reviews.x: I love this product especially because it can straighten and curl my hair at the same time. I have 2 Hair Products for the price of one that I can really say that really does work and saves you time. It Heats up quickly so its ready to get to work on your hair. It also comes with a comb and  two hair clips and a glove. An excellent job straightening my hair with  just one pass is all it takes. And for the curls they come nice and  tight my daughter loves it. The Digital Heating Screen very easy

reviews.t: Love it for my short hair pompadour!
reviews.x: I love using this straightener-with-a-twist! This was my .first time using this product and as you can see, I have short hair (which is also naturally curly) and need it to defy gravity to create my pompadour.  With other flat irons I would often get a kink in my hair when I tried to curl it at the tips of my hair. Not anymore! It's a smooth twist and I am quite pleased. I'm excited to try it on my sister's hair (chin length) to see how the waves come out.  Good price, good product!

This straightener exceeded all expectations, not only does it straighten wonderfully, it also curls my hair so well that I can make the style last for multiple days. I have very fine hair, but a lot of it, and curling or straightening my hair usually takes forever. Not with this straightener, the heat is perfect, heats up fast, you can control the temperature depending on your hair type, and gets the job done quickly. Highly recommend!

I bought this for my 11 year old daughter who is always using my flat iron and curling iron. She has fine, straight hair and is always wanting to have curly hair. She has only used it a couple of times, but LOVES it! It's easy to use and her hair looks super cute. I love how this product gives the option of either curling or straightening your hair, all in one product! Great price too especially for an  11 year old.

I'm very happy with this its quite easy to use and can flip, curl or straighten. It heats up fast and can watch the numbers go up as it heats up to the desired temp. I really like the glove I usually burn my fingers curling my hair but that really helped. And the clips help keep hair back so you can do a section at a time.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product's versatility as a two-in-one straightener and curler.
Many customers find it easy to use, including beginners, though a few mention an initial learning curve.
Customers commonly note that it heats up quickly and is lightweight.
Several reviewers appreciate the included accessories like the heat glove and hair clips.
A minority report problems such as temperature or power button failures, hair not staying straight, and difficulty holding it closed.
